Interface TTLL

public sealed interface TTLL
The choices for each part of the TTLL (Time, Thread, Level, Logger) format, the default text format, configured with TTLLFormatterBuilder or properties of the "ttll" encoder. Property values are the lowercase constant names, for example: 
logging.appender.console.encoder.ttll.timestamp=iso
logging.appender.console.encoder.ttll.keyValues=json5
The defaults produce the classic layout with the event's key values, percent encoded, in braces after the logger name: 12:00:00.123 [main] INFO com.example.App {requestId=42} - hello. When an event has no key values the braces are left out, or written as {}, according to TTLL.KeyValuesWhenEmpty, and TTLL.KeyValuesFormat.NONE leaves the key values out entirely.

Every part also accepts default, which restores its default without naming it, and true and false to show or hide it; the EnumAlias on each constant lists them.
